status: prepared admission lifetime fix; not published
scope: WebSocket base reservation now covers three owners: reader, outgoing writer and exactly-once retirement, plus existing tracked child tasks.
The production write pump completes its owner only after stopping its ticker and closing the socket. Queue-close, write failure and ping failure share that deferred completion path.
Existing in-process fixtures account explicitly for writers they do not launch; real serveWs clients launch both pumps as before. No changed message, wallet, persistence or account authority.

limits: The writer is counted by transport admission, not added to the separate completion-work shutdown group. This does not claim that group joins every outgoing writer or certify shutdown under all operating-system faults.
A controlled actual socket fixture is not a freshly built connected production binary, full credential flow, load soak or certified player capacity. Those assembly gates remain separate.
